title: RingedDerivedRestriction
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with localization morphism universes chosen explicitly. The slice ring and module restriction are [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Define restriction $D(\mathcal O)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ by Mathlib’s functor induced on derived categories by the exact additive module-restriction functor. The comparison on the ring object in degree zero is induced by the canonical single-complex comparison and the localization factorization.
